name: algolia
description: Algolia search and index management powered by the official algolia/mcp server — run queries, list indices, read and update index settings, batch upsert/delete records, manage A/B tests, inspect analytics, configure query suggestions, recommendations, and federated collections, and read usage metrics.

interface.shortDescription: Query, configure, and manage Algolia indexes through the official algolia/mcp server.
interface.longDescription: The Algolia skill exposes the official algolia/mcp server (github.com/algolia/mcp) as a single Fractal toolset. It wraps Algolia's REST APIs behind a stable tool surface so the agent can run full-text searches, list indices, read and write index settings (searchable attributes, ranking, faceting, custom ranking, synonyms, rules), batch upsert and delete records, copy / move / delete indexes, run A/B tests, inspect search analytics, configure query suggestions and recommendation models, set up federated collections, monitor index health, and read usage metrics. All 10 tool groups (search, search_read, search_write, analytics, abtesting, collections, monitoring, querysuggestions, recommend, usage) are enabled by default; restrict to a subset via the MCP_ENABLED_TOOLS env var for a read-only setup.
defaultPrompt: Use the Algolia skill whenever the task involves querying, configuring, or managing an Algolia index — searches, settings, records, A/B tests, analytics, recommendations, or usage.
Prefer `partial_update_objects` over `save_objects` for field-level patches so unset attributes are not clobbered.
Restrict to read-only mode (MCP_ENABLED_TOOLS=search_read,analytics,usage) whenever the agent is exploring data and should not mutate state.
